newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi 52-week T-bill rises to 6.0860 pct.
newsitem.headline: Saudi 52-week T-bill rises to 6.0860 pct.

text.p: The yield on the 52-week Saudi treasury bills worth 500 million riyals rose to 6.0860 percent from 5.9642 percent last month, a banker in Saudi Arabia said.
The bills, offered on Tuesday, are offered once a month by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency to Saudi-based banks.
The average price fell to 94.20313 from 94.31250 last month.
One-year Saudi riyal interbank deposit rates were quoted at 6-3/16, 1/16 percent.
